name: SEATED OVERHEAD TRICEP EXTENSION
introduce: Sit on a bench with your back straight. Gently make both hands into a fist and put them together.\n\nRaise your hands overhead, then lower them down behind your head. Raise them up again, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your upper arms in place.
Breathe in when lowering your hands and breathe out when raising them.
Please squeeze your triceps when raising your hands.
Please tighten your core and stabilize your back.
Please keep your elbows facing forward.
It’s a great exercise for your triceps.
